Package com.nexuslink.protocol.jms

Class JmsService

java.lang.Object
com.nexuslink.protocol.jms.JmsService
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCloseable
public final class JmsService extends Object implements AutoCloseable
A generic JMS client over the ActiveMQ Artemis Jakarta provider: connect to a broker URL, send and receive messages on a queue (Text, Bytes or Map bodies with custom string properties), and peek a queue without consuming (a browser). Artemis speaks the JMS wire (core protocol on tcp://host:61616) and, via AMQP, interoperates with other brokers, so this covers the common "generic JMS" case. Blocking — callers run it off the UI thread.

A single Session (auto-acknowledge) is held for the connection's lifetime; producers, consumers and browsers are created and closed per call.

    • sendMessage

      public String sendMessage(String queueName, JmsService.MessageType type, String body, Map<String,String> properties) throws jakarta.jms.JMSException
      Sends a message of the given type to queueName with optional custom string properties, returning the assigned JMS message id.
      • JmsService.MessageType.TEXT — body is the text.
      • JmsService.MessageType.BYTES — body's UTF-8 bytes are written.
      • JmsService.MessageType.MAP — body is parsed as key=value lines into map entries.
      Throws:
      jakarta.jms.JMSException
